newsitem.title: USA: Regulator backs First Union insurance plan.
newsitem.headline: Regulator backs First Union insurance plan.

text.p: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency said it had approved First Union Corp's proposal to establish operating units to engage in certain general insurance agency activites.

Insurance business units would be established in the following states where First Union banks have branches: North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, Virginia, Maryland, Pennsylvania, New Jersey and New York.

The units would be licensed under applicable state law and engage in general insurance agency activities including life, health, property and casualty, a statement by the regulator of nationally chartered banks said.
